::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
**Days 1–4 — lessons, notebooks, and assignments 1–5 — were written by
[Hassan Algoz](https://github.com/HassanAlgoz) for his
[agentic-ai-systems](https://github.com/HassanAlgoz/agentic-ai-systems)
course, and are reproduced here unchanged, with attribution, plus a sidebar and
navigation to make each lesson easier to follow alongside its code.**

**Day 5, the Capstone Prep page, and assignments 6–9 are additional material
written by Mohammad Yusif** to extend the course to five days and to close the
gaps most often seen in submitted capstone projects.
:::

This course walks through building real Agentic AI systems with
**LangChain** (the framework), **LangGraph** (the runtime), and
**LangSmith** (the platform) — from a single tool-calling agent all the way
to multi-agent, stateful systems with memory and retrieval.

Every lesson below pairs the explanation with the runnable notebook, so you
can read the "why" and the code side by side on one page. Use the sidebar
on the left to jump straight to any lesson.

## Pre-Course Assessment

Before starting, take the short pre-assessment — 12 quick questions, about
10 minutes. It helps gauge where the group is starting from so the course can
be pitched at the right level. It is **not** graded as part of the course.

[**Take the pre-assessment →**](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfvHEwXZ804k90Ax32ZeHjhPPJo8DcUti1DL9-yMMNbw2sG7w/viewform){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}
